title: Agent tab: terminal body, tab-panel discovery, tab name and waiting dot
summary: Ships the agent tab: a live xterm.js terminal wired to the agent runtime, tab-panel discovery for other screens, tab name and waiting dot, in the liquid-glass tokens; approved by two fresh reviews and merged on a green local Windows gate (CI blocked by billing).

deferred.what: The fixed tab-panel slot set body | controls | header has no place above the terminal or for a right-hand column, yet the meeting prototype puts the question card above the terminal and own-time answering puts the ticket row above it and the Questions card to its right; issue #91 (meeting panel) and issue #92 (own-time answering screen) cannot match their prototypes without editing this folder, and would collide if run in parallel.
deferred.why: A new slot is a design decision outside this story's fixed slot list.

deferred.what: Send writes the text and then Enter as a separate write; on a long line Claude Code may not have finished echoing, so the Enter can be lost and the message never sent.
deferred.why: The runtime's wait-until-quiet Enter is not reachable from the renderer; that code belongs to the agent runtime.
